summary_short: EchoStar's Q2 FY2026 revenue was $3.58B, down 4.0% y/y, while net income swung to $8.46B from a year-ago loss; cash fell 81.2% y/y to $440.0M and equity fell 28.3% y/y to $14.16B.
summary_long: Revenue was $3.58B, down 4.0% y/y and 2.5% q/q. Gross profit rose 35.2% y/y to $1.23B, lifting gross margin to about 34.4% from 24.4% a year ago. Operating income turned positive at $512.9M versus a $213.4M loss a year ago. Diluted EPS was $24.12 versus a $1.06 loss a year ago, on net income of $8.46B versus a $306.1M loss. Cash fell 81.2% y/y to $440.0M; equity fell 28.3% y/y to $14.16B.
